title: Applying a lifted action
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, $S$ a type, and $x$ a finite Boolean string. For every action $a$ on $k+1$ work tapes with states in $S$, every configuration $c$ for that machine on input $x$, every additional tape contents function $tape : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, every integer position $p$, and every optional state $s \in \mathrm{Option}(S \oplus \mathrm{Fin}(3))$, applying the lifted action to the lifted configuration built from $c$ and $tape$, with its state replaced by $s$, gives the lifted configuration of the result of applying $a$ to $c$, with additional tape contents still $tape$ and additional head position $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action on $k+1$ work tapes with states in $S$
$c$ is a configuration for that machine on input $x$
